glosses: to squeeze off, to scrape together (to take a (usually small) amount out of something)

examples.translation: to take the time; to squeeze off time
examples.english: to take the time; to squeeze off time

glosses: Enlever avec un mouvement de pincement.

examples.text: Das hat auch mit der gemeinsamen Geschichte zu tun, in deren Verlauf – russisch-iranische Kriege vom 17. bis 19. Jahrhundert – das zaristische Russland immer wieder iranisches Territorium abzwacken konnte.
examples.translation: Cela tient aussi à l'histoire commune au cours de laquelle - guerres russo-iraniennes du XVIIe au XIXe siècle - la Russie tsariste a toujours réussi à se couper des pièces du territoire iranien.

examples.text: Sie zwackte einen Teil des Brotes ab.

glosses: einen kleinen Teil von etwas (ohnehin schon Knappem) für einen anderen (eigenen) Zweck wegnehmen

examples.text: Er hat mir einen kleinen Teil von meinen Verdiensten abgezwackt.

glosses: To isolate or remove from contact.

examples.text: The entranced spectator was cut off from reality as long as the adventure lasted; it was as if he lived a dream yet believed he was awake.

glosses: To stop the provision or supply of something, e.g. power, water.

examples.text: The first English Electric units were not fitted with an anti-slip brake, but a hurried consultation of the wiring diagram showed that it should be possible to hold in the low-voltage anti-slip relay for long enough to let speed build up without cutting off the motor current.

glosses: To stop providing funds or something else to (someone).

examples.text: His parents cut him off to encourage him to find a job.
You're drunk, Jerry, I'm cutting you off.
My phone call was cut off before I could get the information.
That dingbat cut me off as I was about to conclude my thesis.

glosses: To swerve in front of (another car) while driving.
To move so as to block someone else's movement in a direction.

examples.text: I ran to the house, but Sally is quicker and cut me off.

glosses: To turn off or switch off (an electrical device).

examples.text: Cut off the lamp so I can get some sleep.

glosses: To separate (something) from something else, using a pinching motion.

examples.text: Jackie Allen was my friend Phil’s girlfriend, and I pinched her off him, slowly, patiently, over a period of months.
